震旦国际大楼顶层办公室。

林川打开顾城发来的邮件附件。

几页背景调查资料弹了出来。

宋清父亲，卢湾区房管局副科长。母亲，区教育局干事。

名下两套老洋房拆分的公房。

林川往下翻。

宋清本人，复旦本硕连读，留校任教后转至上海财大辅导员。

他靠回椅背，手指敲了两下桌面。

张虎这小子，命倒是好，找了个这样的姑娘。

但宋家那种老派体制内家庭的择婿标准，不用猜都知道——上海户口，正经编制，家世清白。

一个外地来的大专生，干着进出口的倒卖生意。

在他们眼里，连上桌的资格都没有。

林川把资料存进文件夹，关掉电脑。

周五傍晚。上海财大校门外。

一辆崭新的黑色宾利欧陆稳稳停在路边。

流线型的车身在夕阳下泛着冷光。

路过的学生纷纷侧目，几个男生停下脚步打量车标。

林小冉背着书包走出校门。几个女同学跟在她身边。

“小冉，明天周末去逛街？”

“明天说呗，我哥来接我吃饭。”

林小冉挥挥手，径直走向路边那辆惹眼的豪车。拉开副驾驶车门。

几个女同学看着那辆车，眼睛发亮，低声交头接耳。

车门合上。隔绝了外面的视线。

林川踩下油门。宾利平稳汇入车流。

“哥，昨天我在校门口碰到虎哥了。”

林小冉系好安全带，转头看着林川。“他身边还跟着我们学校的宋老师。”

林川看着前方路况。“你觉得宋老师怎么样？”

“特别好。”林小冉语气兴奋。“长得漂亮，说话温温柔柔的。我上周去问选修课的学分问题，她特别有耐心。哥，虎哥那种糙汉子，能找到宋老师，真是祖坟冒青烟了。”

林川轻笑一声。“张虎也不差。”

林小冉撇撇嘴。“虎哥人是好，但这可是上海。宋老师家里能同意吗？”

Office on the top floor of Aurora International Building.

Lin Chuan opened the email attachment sent by Gu Cheng.

Several pages of background check information popped up.

Song Qing’s father is the deputy section chief of Luwan District Housing Management Bureau.Mother, director of the District Education Bureau.

A public house split from two old bungalows under my name.

Lin Chuan turned down.

Song Qing himself studied at Fudan University with a bachelor's degree and a master's degree. He stayed at the school to teach and then became a counselor at Shanghai University of Finance and Economics.

He leaned back in his chair and tapped his fingers on the table twice.

This kid Zhang Hu is lucky enough to have found a girl like this.

But you don’t need to guess the criteria for choosing a son-in-law for a family like the Song family in the old-school system—Shanghai household registration, formal establishment, and a clean family background.

A college student from out of town is engaged in the import and export reselling business.

In their eyes, they are not even qualified to serve on the table.

Lin Chuan saved the information into a folder and turned off the computer.

Friday evening.Outside the gate of Shanghai University of Finance and Economics.

A brand new black Bentley Continental was parked steadily on the roadside.

The streamlined body glows coldly in the sunset.

The students passing by looked sideways, and a few boys stopped to look at the car logo.

Lin Xiaoran walked out of the school gate with his schoolbag on his back.Several female classmates followed her.

"Xiao Ran, are you going shopping tomorrow on the weekend?"

"Let's talk tomorrow. My brother will pick me up for dinner."

Lin Xiaoran waved his hand and walked straight to the eye-catching luxury car on the side of the road.Open the passenger door.

Several female classmates looked at the car, their eyes bright, and they whispered to each other in low voices.

The car door closes.Isolated from outside view.

Lin Chuan stepped on the accelerator.The Bentley merged smoothly into traffic.

"Brother, I met Brother Hu at the school gate yesterday."

Lin Xiaoran fastened his seat belt and turned to look at Lin Chuan."He is also accompanied by Teacher Song from our school."

Lin Chuan looked at the road ahead."What do you think of Teacher Song?"

"Excellent." Lin Xiaoran sounded excited."She is pretty and speaks softly. I went to ask about the credits for elective courses last week, and she was very patient. Brother, a rough guy like Brother Hu can find Teacher Song, which is really a blessing in disguise."

Lin Chuan chuckled."Zhang Hu is not bad either."

Lin Xiaoran curled his lips."Brother Hu is a nice person, but this is Shanghai. Can Teacher Song's family agree?"
